alt: Sandals and flip-flops left in rows on a doorstep, seen from above. A ginger and white cat sits among them, washing one paw.
Three children playing in front of a pale blue house. A girl in pink is caught mid-jump above the yard while a boy runs along the veranda behind her.
Children playing a throwing game with their sandals on a concrete yard. Two boys lean forward mid-throw while a girl crouches beside the bottle they are aiming at.
An arm reaches in from the right to turn a key in the lock of a red wooden door.
Two hands meet over a market table as money changes hands. A man in sunglasses stands at the stall and the seller sits behind it in a white headscarf.
A vegetable seller sits behind his stall, framed from the chest down. Long beans and bitter gourd are spread on foil in front of him with handwritten price cards.
An older woman in a lace headscarf stands behind her market table, greens and aubergines laid out with handwritten price cards.
A couple walking through the market, photographed from the waist down, their hands just meeting between them. The stall behind is numbered 58.
A close-up of my wife's eye. Palm trees and the figure taking the photograph are reflected in the iris.
A white stone Buddha in a temple garden, one hand raised in teaching, with disciples seated around him. Paper lanterns hang from the trees above.
Four dogs on a tiled lane. A small brown one stands in the middle of the frame looking up, and a shaggy grey one crowds the lens at the right edge.
Three men at a pavement cafe table. One plays a guitar while the other two look at their phones.
Concrete graves set among banana palms and coffee bushes, with a village and green hills beyond.
A timber house in Vietnam with blue doors and shutters, a bed of flowers along its front, farmland on either side and mist on the hills behind.
A flatbed truck loaded high with green coconuts, parked at the roadside under a palm.
A girl stands in the doorway of a house, a woman behind her in the dark of the hall. Sandals lie on the bare ground outside.
A woman in a yellow dress standing on the low branch of a mango tree, her face hidden by the leaves.
The same mango tree a moment later. She has moved further along the branch, barefoot now, her face just visible through the leaves.
A small wooden church with a narrow steeple, seen from across the road under power lines and a heavy sky.
A large white wooden church with a steep gable and a square bell tower, palms in the foreground.
A church gate seen from below. The iron arch above it reads “Jezus zegt komt herwaarts tot mij”.
Dawn at Leonsberg. A long exposure smooths the river around the pilings of a broken jetty.
A woman walking towards the camera past shuttered shopfronts in Paramaribo, looking straight into the lens. Two people rest in a doorway behind her.
Three women waiting beside a minibus on a Paramaribo street. The nearest looks at the camera as she eats.
A woman leans out of a minibus window, laughing, her arm resting along the sill.
A clothes seller in a cap works under the market awning, customers crowding the stall around him.
Two minibuses at a bus stand. Beside one, a woman reaches up to the window to speak to a passenger while another waits with their bags on the ground.
A pickup parked in front of a two-storey wooden house, half of it painted dark and half left bare, with long grass across the yard.
